caveat: The other four of ten are about manual work, which is the job the platform already does well. The risk objection is the one that remains unanswered after signing: no trial, no mid-cycle downgrade.
source: Brand Value Stream: Getting Started, First 90 Days (Sept 2026)
statement: Six of ten pre-sale brand objections are about risk, not product: cost, the 12-month commitment, and no guarantee of partners.
